ideas.name: room: the next round 100 ahead is 1 two-minute ATR away or more
ideas.why: round numbers are magnets and resistance; a target past one fights it

ideas.name: on the trade's side of the overnight midpoint
ideas.why: the night's balance point; a breakout away from it has the overnight inventory behind it

ideas.name: on the trade's side of the week's open
ideas.why: the week's open is the weekly traders' reference; above it they are net long

ideas.name: on the trade's side of the month's open
ideas.why: the month's open is where monthly flows are measured; the month's winners add

ideas.name: inside the VWAP 1-sigma bands
ideas.why: beyond a band the move is already extended against the day's distribution

ideas.name: beyond the VWAP 1-sigma band its way
ideas.why: a break outside the day's normal range is the distribution shifting: a trend day

ideas.name: room to the 20-session high (long) / low (short): 1 ADR or more
ideas.why: the month's extreme is resistance; a breakout well below it has room

ideas.name: a new 20-session high (long) / low (short)
ideas.why: a break to a new monthly extreme has no overhead supply and draws momentum funds
